title: 宝塚記念の後に・熱を受けて！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen felt like a dream! I felt everyone's passion, light, and dreams while I ran alongside them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I ran this race! I can still feel everyone's dreams burning so hot! I want to pit my dream against theirs again someday!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My next goal race is the Sprinters Stakes! I've got to stand at the summit of sprints if I want to become Oguri's ultimate rival!
